title: daap-get-library
author: Patrik Karlsson
description: Retrieves a list of music from a DAAP server. The list includes artist names and album and song titles. Output will be capped to 100 items if not otherwise specified in the daap_item_limit script argument. A daap_item_limit below zero outputs the complete contents of the DAAP library. Based on documentation found here: http://www.tapjam.net/daap/.
